non_blocking_notes: Section 4 says "Keep the function name unless a rename is needed solely for clarity" for tests/test_package.py::test_init_public_surface_exports_m2_provider_handle_surface, while acceptance criteria 1 and 6 invoke that exact node id. The permission and the pinned node id are in tension; an executor that renames would break its own acceptance commands. Verified at the ref that the test exists under that exact name (git show 4b16c57:tests/test_package.py) and that its expected set is exactly the ten names the plan lists plus to_utc.

Section 5 says to monkeypatch load_packaged_catalogue_artifact but does not name the module attribute to patch. Since it is imported by-name elsewhere (git grep -n "def load_packaged_catalogue_artifact" 4b16c57 -- src shows it defined in src/rivretrieve/_internal/catalogues/artifact.py, and tests/test_package.py imports it by name), patching the defining module would not intercept already-bound references. Harmless here because to_utc must never call it, so the probe's outcome is unaffected either way.

Section 6 states the full-suite expectation as "1622 passed, 2 skipped plus the four newly authored" rather than writing the resulting total (1626 passed, 2 skipped). Derivable, but one fewer inference if written out.

Section 2 pins ZoneValue as the dispatch domain but does not spell out the behaviour for a time_zone cell that is neither 'unknown' nor a valid ZoneValue (ObservationDataSchema types time_zone only as pl.Utf8, so such a cell can reach to_utc). Using ZoneValue makes the outcome a propagated ValueError, which is determinate, and the approved summary reserves no other answer, so no assertion is required.

Verified the plan's quantitative claims directly: src/rivretrieve/_internal/providers/usgs_nwis/catalogue/native.parquet has 26258 rows and exactly six distinct tz_cd values ['AKST','CST','EST','HST','MST','PST'], and stations.parquet carries exactly ['provider_id','station_id','latitude','longitude','crs'] with no zone column. Both match the plan verbatim.
summary: The plan is self-sufficient for a zero-context, no-network executor. I reconstructed the write-set independently and found nothing it omits: to_utc does not exist at 4b16c57 (git grep -n "to_utc" 4b16c57 -- src tests docs returns only docs/milestone-tracker.md and docs/provider_ports/* prose, proving the search works and the name is unused in src/tests), so the change reaches exactly src/rivretrieve/_internal/utc.py, src/rivretrieve/__init__.py, tests/test_utc.py, tests/test_data/usgs_nwis_07374000_iv_00060_2023-03-12-dst.json, and tests/test_package.py. The only existing assertion whose expected value changes is test_init_public_surface_exports_m2_provider_handle_surface, whose exact-set comparison I read at the ref; the plan updates it and quotes the complete eleven-name set. Every test the plan claims untouched exists under the exact name given (verified one by one) and is genuinely unaffected: test_provider_architecture_contracts.py scans only PROVIDERS_ROOT (src/rivretrieve/_internal/providers/*/*.py), so its ZoneInfo/astimezone/replace(tzinfo=...) ban and its _make_fetch_window import ban do not reach _internal/utc.py or tests/; test_domain_context.py only asserts fixed CONTEXT.md substrings; no repo test enumerates _internal modules or tests/test_data. Authored data is complete and typable: the DST fixture is quoted in full as literal JSON with rows at -06:00 and -05:00, and the expected instants are arithmetically correct (01:30-06:00 -> 07:30Z, 03:30-05:00 -> 08:30Z), as are the fixed-offset (+05:30 -> 2025-12-31 18:45, -03:30 -> 2026-01-01 03:45) and Europe/Zurich (Jan 12:00 -> 11:00, Jul 12:00 -> 10:00) frames. The exact FatalContractError string and its f-string template agree, and repr of a NewType-based ProviderId yields 'ca_eccc' as written. Every constructed carrier type-checks against source: SourceCallOrigin has exactly the seven fields the plan passes positionally, Issue accepts code: str and details: dict, ObservationProvenance accepts metadata: str | None, ZoneValue admits IANA/±HH:MM/unknown, and ObservationDataSchema.polars_schema exists on CatalogueSchema and yields datetime[us]. The decided behaviour is stated and closed, not reopened: row's own published zone, no IANA promotion, no catalogue or tz_cd lookup, multi-offset spans converted rather than rejected, unknown as the sole rejection detected atomically before any conversion via a named _convert_wall_clock helper, provider taken from provenance.provider_id with no provider_id column. The plan explicitly forbids editing ADR-0007's stale tz_cd prose. Reversibility holds: no version bump (0.1.49 confirmed in both pyproject.toml and __init__.py), no tag, no push, no publish, pr-body.md untracked, one conventional commit, gates in the stated order with typecheck scoped to src and no mention of tests/typecheck/nominal_window_misuse.py, and section 8 retains the not-touched fence and the exact expected values rather than a pre-derived correctness argument. Scope matches the approved summary exactly, with no creep.
